review_text_raw:
I felt like this game wasn't that impressive.

The story was uninteresting, the acting was horrible, and there were multiple grammar errors that made the texts really painful to read through. Plus, for a fast reader like me, the game went way too slow, and I felt like half the time I was just waiting for the game to finish loading whatever dialogue was supposed to come next. This game isn't worth your time.

review_text_raw: The acting in this game is atrocious. The characters are unpleasant and you aren't given nearly any choice as to whether you do as they say or not. The two characters you interact with for the first chunk of the game are both men who treat the disapearance of Anna as entertaining and a personal affront respectively, and your character gives them all the information they request without hesitation. The jumpscares and supernatural elements are dull and overplayed. Other games have used this genre to create engaging puzzles like figuring out someones password by reading through their texts and checking their photos. This game holds your hand through these things and straight up has other characters tell you what to do, ruining the immerison. Then they add more immerison breaking puzzles by scrambling the order of some texts and images on the phone that the player then has put in order. This is a boring puzzle and the revealed texts and images are usually unsatisfying.
